title: Safety Scrimshaw — SOC2 prep scratchpad (Lucy)
summary: Loose notebook-style runthrough for scoping and initial evidence collection. Rapid Qs, quick mappings to owners, and immediate next actions to unblock our first readiness checkpoint.
content:
Purpose: quick, chewable notes to help me and a couple folks get from fuzzy scope -> concrete evidence tasks. Not for sharing externally; heavily in-progress.

Top-level scope
- Systems in-scope: hosted-api, dedicated-control-plane, private-deploy control plane (VPC). Focus first on hosted-api infra + control plane config.
- Data in-scope: customer prompt/response logs (non-PII staging), API keys (secrets), telemetry (metrics/traces).
- Exclude: third-party model weights; include inference orchestration that touches customer data.

Initial control mapping (sketch)
- Access management: AD/IDP lists -> owners: infra-iam (Mateo). Evidence: access review screenshots, policy doc, last 3 months audit log.
- Change management: release-engineering -> owners: release-eng (Priya). Evidence: changelog + rollout canary notes + PR approvals.
- Logging & monitoring: SRE/observability -> owners: observability (Anita). Evidence: alert rules, retention policy, recent alert incident blameless notes.
- Key management: security -> owners: security (Rohan). Evidence: KMS config, KMS rotation record, HSM proof-of-contract.

Quick risk questions to resolve (my shorthand)
- Where do staging logs live vs prod logs? Are they segregated at ingestion? Need diagram and exact bucket names.
- What tokens are stored in DB vs ephemeral? Which services decrypt at runtime?
- Does Redwood-hosted API ever write customer payloads to long-term cold storage for debug? If yes, retention policy?
- Which control plane operations require human approval vs automated? Example: new model onboarding in hosted catalog.

Evidence collection checklist (first pass)
- IAM: list of active SSO groups + last 90d user provisioning audit (screenshot + export CSV).
- Secrets: inventory of secret stores + who has create/list permissions.
- Deploys: PR->CI->deploy pipeline run for last 30 days + canary rollback proof.
- Backups: snapshot schedule for primary DBs + restore DR test notes (date + person).
- Encryption: KMS key arn + rotation TTL + a note on who can schedule rotation.
- Vendor contracts: KMS/HSM provider + SLA doc link.

Sampling plan ideas
- Random sample 10 API tokens created in last 30 days and confirm proper ACLs.
- Pick two recent deploys (one feature, one infra) and walk the changelog -> approvals -> post-deploy monitoring.

Open threads / blockers
- Need confirmation from infra-iam on whether service accounts are in shared groups (blocking isolation proof). Mateo to PT.
- Release-eng needs to produce a short doc describing canary thresholds used in last 6 months. Priya to fetch.
- Observability retention: default syslog retention seems 180 days but we only have proof for 30 days in current doc. Asking Anita for retention-policy artifact.

Notes to self (practical)
- Keep evidence filenames consistent: evidence/<control>-<artifact>-YYYYMMDD.<ext> so auditors don't ask for clarifications.
- When asking for screenshots, request both UI path + API export (CSV) where possible.
- Prefer timestamped exports rather than ad-hoc screenshots.

Planned timeline (rough)
- Week 1: finalize in-scope list + owner confirmations (this week).
- Week 2: collect high-value evidence (IAM, deploy pipelines, KMS).
- Week 3: sampling + fill gaps; prepare internal readiness memo.

Draft messages (quick copy)
- To infra-iam: "Hi — working on SOC2 readiness. Can you send active SSO groups CSV and last 90d provisioning audit? Need by EOD Wed. Thanks — Lucy."
- To release-eng: "Short ask: two recent deploys (feature + infra) with PR links and canary metrics. Also the last rollback. Hit me back w/ links."

Heuristics / quick decisions
- If evidence exists but not timestamped, request timestamped export — auditors always ask.
- If owner is ambiguous, start with the team that touched the component in last deploy.

Random scratch ideas (possible future artifacts)
- Lightweight runbook demonstrating how to produce an evidence bundle for a control (one-click export cheat-sheet).
- A small script to export last 90d IAM events to CSV (to avoid manual screenshots).

Unresolved questions for review call
- Does Private deployment log routing obey the same retention & masking rules as hosted? If not, how do we demonstrate comparability?
- Are there any special agreements with cloud providers about forensic access we need to disclose?

To-dos (next 48h)
- [ ] Confirm owner list and send templated asks (Lucas).
- [ ] Pull one sample deploy trace and attach to this doc.
- [ ] Export SSO groups CSV (Mateo).

End. Treat this as my ephemeral scratchpad — will clean and push to Confluence once owners confirm artifacts.

- slack thread: #trust-prep (search "evidence export")
